rules: W is a coupling fabric, not a residency metric.
Source pseudo-volume and operational information remain different local carriers.
Every change of decomposition, reference frame, code space, or process geometry exposes a cost and a test.
Evidence remains external; no telemetry facade promotes its own claim.
Worldlet, Tendril, weave, deweave, and OmniTool remain S-tier architecture unless their declared operators are explicitly exercised.

bridge.attenuated_not_lost: rho is not declared lost: det(A)=exp(-2*rho) recovers it in exact arithmetic, but fixed additive delta-rho sensitivity decays and tomography becomes shot-expensive.
bridge.nontransported_aggregate: Cartan source-volume multiplicity is a measure over source descriptions, not a state field or an operational codeword count.
preserved: rho at finite depth under exact density tomography
bridge.side_channel: No free classical ||M||_2 register is supplied. Any such register, extra width, repeated use, energy, or time must be declared and charged.

operational.carrier: five-dimensional complex density operators from the declared fixed Bell-probe erasure instrument
operational.geometry: trace distance, root fidelity, Bures distance, and SLD quantum Fisher information
operational.information: finite-ensemble PGM, Holevo, oracle-erasure, and log2-cardinality bracket in bits

source.carrier: SL(2,R) determinant-one real matrices in Cartan coordinates (rho,phi,psi)
source.forbidden_projection: The split form and source volume are never used as an operational distance or as bits.

C1.gate: Source volume, Bell success, density validity, projective M~-M alias, split-form rejection, and the existing information sandwich remain green.
C1.name: R7 and R6 binding

C10.gate: Two different Worldlet geometries are present; the Tendril lists preserved, transformed, lost, cost, typed remainder, and absent return reason; source Quantity and operational Bits refuse comparison.

tendril.return_absent_reason: The density identifies M with -M, and exact tomography is not a parameter-independent CPTP inverse. A physical inverse word is separately costed by echo_transport.

C10.name: typed AION seam

C11.gate: Empty deweave reasons are refused, routing events are append-only, and physical echo_transport is never implemented through Tendril.deweave.
C11.name: weave/deweave history

C12.gate: The finite ensemble obeys PGM<=Holevo<=oracle<=log2N; output binds the frozen manifest, source, tests, and runner in an EvidenceEnvelope without claiming independence.

metrics.local_envelope_verification: required after immutable result emission; failure raises

C12.name: information and evidence

C2.gate: Closed trace distance and fidelity agree with dense spectral calculations within 1e-10, and Fuchs-van de Graaf plus Helstrom bounds hold.
C2.name: dense versus closed pair geometry

C3.gate: Numerical Bures reconstruction agrees with the analytic QFI on every frozen interior point within 0.5 percent relative error.
C3.name: QFI reconstruction

C4.gate: rho=0 is handled by finite trace/fidelity probes and is never passed to the interior SLD-QFI API.
C4.name: rank-changing boundary

C5.gate: q decreases monotonically to zero, J_rhorho has high-depth log slope -4 within 0.02, J_qq remains finite near q=0, and the analytic total QFI volume matches sqrt(2)*pi^3.
C5.name: coordinate compactification

C6.gate: kappa is non-negative, the cocycle defect is below 1e-10, and normalized-product plus stream/direct identities hold.
C6.name: normalization cocycle

C7.gate: Every frozen inverse pair has source defect below 1e-10, conditional fidelity one within 1e-10, and the two declared success laws.
C7.name: source echo versus attempted survival

C8.gate: The frozen depolarizing channel never increases dense trace distance, never decreases root fidelity, and its finite-difference QFI does not exceed the input beyond numerical tolerance.
C8.name: CPTP data processing

C9.gate: Common SO(2) frame attacks preserve the declared invariants, while the existing matched SU(2) family keeps the same probe and density width.
C9.name: compact frame and matched compact family

excluded_claims: Adding, averaging, ranking, or optimizing source pseudo-volume and operational bits as one scalar.
Calling the indefinite source Q=+1 geometry positive-definite H3.
Calling rho literally lost at finite depth when exact tomography can recover q=exp(-2rho).
Calling fixed-rho QFI decay deletion of a fixed-q distinction.
Treating source volume, constructed descriptions, N*p, QFI volume, or catalogue size as channel capacity.
Treating Tendril.deweave as M inverse or as a CPTP recovery map.
Keeping ||M||_2 as an uncharged infinite-precision classical side register.
Changing the path, threshold, finite-difference step, channel, controls, or tolerances after observing outputs.
Claiming quantum advantage, hardware performance, noise robustness, cognition, consciousness, AGI, or general memory benefit.
